description.en: Original stylized karst sinkhole teaching cutaway: an enclosed surface funnel narrows into a real open throat and an enlarged underground cavity. The artificial front subsurface section reveals rock thickness and the connection without opening the surface rim. Nominal 6 m tile, dimensions, low cover, palette and exposed section are artistic choices, not measured site, dated event, collapse sequence or hydrology. No water. The artificial front cutaway and rear-half base are not collision-ready natural cave geometry. At small hero size the throat is not fully legible; top/front views are needed to explain the internal connection.
description.zh: 原创风格化喀斯特落水洞教学剖面：闭合周缘地表真实下凹，经窄喉连接扩大的地下空腔。人工前侧地下剖切展示岩壁厚度和空腔连接，同时保持地表漏斗周缘闭合。名义6米裁片、各部尺寸、低矮覆盖、配色及展示剖面均为美术选择，不代表实测地点、年代事件、塌陷过程或水文。无水。 人工前剖面及后半底部不是可直接用于碰撞的自然洞穴几何；小尺寸主视图不能充分显示窄喉，解释内部连接时需配合俯视和前视。
